title: Wow! 신호

images.prompt: Big Ear radio telescope, rural Ohio, USA, August 1977: a huge flat field-like radio telescope at night: a long tilted metal reflector wall and a vast flat aluminium ground plane gleaming faintly under a deep starry sky with the Milky Way, a small control building beside it with one single lit window, nobody around.

Big Ear radio telescope, rural Ohio, USA, August 1977: an empty 1970s observatory control room at night: an old mainframe computer cabinet with blinking lights and a line printer slowly feeding out a long ribbon of folded printout paper onto the floor all by itself, an empty swivel chair, one desk lamp, printed characters blurred and unreadable.

1977: close-up of folded computer printout paper on a wooden kitchen table under a lamp at night, long columns of tiny printed characters blurred and unreadable, one short vertical sequence circled boldly with red pen and a red handwritten scribble in the margin (unreadable), a red pen lying beside it.

Big Ear radio telescope, rural Ohio, USA, August 1977: the night sky above the telescope toward the constellation Sagittarius, the dense glowing core of the Milky Way, the long dark reflector of the telescope as a silhouette along the bottom, one faint strange point of light among the stars.

Big Ear radio telescope, rural Ohio, USA, August 1977: close view at night of two identical horn-shaped radio receiver feeds standing side by side at the focus of the telescope: the left horn glows with a faint cold light, the right horn is completely dark and silent, stars above.

Rural Ohio today at night: an empty open grassy field with a few trees under a vast starry sky where a giant radio telescope once stood, only faint old concrete foundation marks in the grass, silent, nobody there.

scenes.say: 외계인을 찾던 주파수에, 72초 동안 무언가 들어왔습니다.
scenes.tts: 외계인을 찾던 주파수에 칠십이 초 동안 무언가 들어왔습니다.
천구백칠십칠 년 미국, 사람 없는 관측소의 기록입니다.

scenes.say: 며칠 뒤 기록지를 본 천문학자는, 빨간 펜으로 적습니다. 와우.
scenes.tts: 며칠 뒤 기록지를 본 천문학자는, 빨간 펜으로 적습니다. 와우.
scenes.sub: 며칠 뒤 기록지를 본 천문학자는, 빨간 펜으로 적습니다. 'Wow!'

scenes.tts: 평소 잡음보다 삼십 배 강한 신호였죠.

scenes.say: 우주에서 왔다면, 몇 분 뒤 옆 안테나에도 잡혀야 했죠. 그런데… 두 번째는 없었습니다.
scenes.tts: 우주에서 왔다면, 몇 분 뒤 옆 안테나에도 잡혀야 했죠. 그런데, 두 번째는 없었습니다.
그 뒤 사십구 년, 다시는 들리지 않았습니다.
그 칠십이 초는, 어디서 온 걸까요?
